summary: Full price/action refresh applied to the live Power Stack watchlist. Current regime shifted to inflationary geopolitical risk + higher-rate pressure after renewed US-Iran/Hormuz escalation. Candidate cards now display change versus the prior snapshot. A stable latest-market-review feed was added so Current Holdings on the watchlist can show latest price, session move and action without contaminating fundamentals-only scores. Watchlist UI now uses the live review date and active market-regime strip instead of the stale Aug 28 header.

Full daily research refresh. No holding fundamental-score or base-conviction changes. MN Holdings research priority raised after FY26 revenue +61% to RM869.19M and PAT +92% to RM92.47M, with substation engineering ~88% of revenue, strengthening the Malaysia grid/data-centre infrastructure thesis. Unitree reviewed as a newly listed robotics opportunity but remains watch-only: real shipments/revenue are offset by post-IPO valuation volatility and falling adjusted profit. AGKO remains high-priority IPO watch. Johor data-centre spillover remains supportive for TNB/cable/substation infrastructure. Sunday oil rebound on Hormuz tension is treated tactically, not as a structural upstream upgrade. Robotics commercialisation sequence unchanged. Official ISM re-verified: July remains latest (Manufacturing 55.6, Services 54.1); Sep 1/Sep 3 remain next releases. Research/data only; no site code, UI, scoring, automation or backend changes.
